# JoroSpray

> JoroSpray is a plant-based spider spray (an EPA FIFRA 25(b) minimum-risk pesticide) made for Joro spiders (Trichonephila clavata), the large yellow invasive orb-weaver spreading across Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee and Alabama. Based in Atlanta, Georgia.

## Product
- JoroSpray Spider Spray, 16 fl oz: $24.99 + $5.99 shipping; 2-pack $39.99 and 3-pack $54.99 with free shipping.
- 1-gallon refill: $59.99, free shipping.
- Ingredients: peppermint oil, cinnamon oil and geraniol; all ingredients listed on the label.
- Kills many common spiders on contact; spraying webs and anchor points repels spiders so they move on. Reapply after rain.
- Status: first batch ships spring 2027. Join the waitlist at https://jorospray.com/#ready

## Bulk and wholesale
- Bulk pricing (gallons, 5-gallon pails, 55-gallon drums) for cities, counties, parks and recreation departments, schools, event venues, outdoor dining and property managers: https://jorospray.com/#bulk
- Retailer and distributor inquiries: hello@jorospray.com

## About Joro spiders
- First found near Hoschton, Georgia (I-85) around 2013-2014; now across much of the Southeast.
- Adults are most visible August through November.
- Experts say their bite is rarely an issue.
